parameters.query:
WITH cible AS (
    SELECT
        rv.id,
        rv.reference,
        rv.creneau_id,
        rv.statut
    FROM rendez_vous rv
    WHERE rv.token_gestion = $1::uuid
    FOR UPDATE
),
annulation AS (
    UPDATE rendez_vous rv
    SET
        statut = 'ANNULE',
        motif_annulation = $2,
        cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    FROM cible c
    WHERE rv.id = c.id
      AND c.statut = 'CONFIRME'
    RETURNING
        rv.id,
        rv.reference,
        rv.creneau_id,
        rv.statut,
        rv.cancelled_at
),
liberation AS (
    UPDATE creneaux cr
    SET places_reservees = GREATEST(cr.places_reservees - 1, 0)
    FROM annulation a
    WHERE cr.id = a.creneau_id
    RETURNING
        cr.id,
        cr.capacite,
        cr.places_reservees
)
SELECT
    a.id,
    a.reference,
    a.statut,
    a.cancelled_at,
    l.capacite,
    l.places_reservees,
    l.capacite - l.places_reservees AS places_disponibles
FROM annulation a
JOIN liberation l ON l.id = a.creneau_id;
